item.title: Rachel’s Kitchen: Fresh, Feel-Good Dining Locals Love
item.description: Rachel’s Kitchen in Summerlin offers fresh, healthy meals, all-day breakfast, salads, sandwiches, and smoothies in a casual, welcoming setting locals love.

item.title: Santina’s New York Pizzeria: A Sun City Favorite
item.description: Visit Santina’s New York Pizzeria near Sun City Summerlin for thin-crust NY-style pizza, pasta, salads, wine, and a cozy family-friendly dining experience.

item.title: Istanbul Mediterranean 2 Brings Comfort to Fremont East
item.description: Istanbul Mediterranean 2 opens on Fremont East, serving authentic Turkish cuisine, late-night comfort food, and a full sit-down dining experience in downtown Las Vegas.

item.title: Double Zero Pie & Pub Brings Big Pizza Energy to Chinatown
item.description: Discover Double Zero Pie & Pub in Las Vegas Chinatown, where craft beer, inventive starters, and standout Neo-Neapolitan pizza create one of the city’s most memorable pizza nights.

item.title: Sophia Booth Is Building Nevada’s Next Service Movement
item.description: Las Vegas student Sophia Booth is building real community impact through Girls Together, Nevada Youth Day of Service, and youth-led service across Nevada.

item.title: Rumi Room Brings Persian Flavor to Las Vegas’ Southwest Side
item.description: Discover Rumi Room in southwest Las Vegas, where Persian and Indo-Pak cuisine come together in a warm, stylish setting with generous portions, bold spices, and memorable kabobs.

item.title: Novella Italian Kitchen: A Cozy Italian Spot
item.description: Novella Italian Kitchen in Las Vegas offers fresh pasta, artisan pizzas, and a cozy dining experience with friendly service and a full bar menu.

item.title: 888 Japanese BBQ Encore Las Vegas Review – AYCE Grill Experience Off the Strip
item.description: Step inside 888 Japanese BBQ Encore in Las Vegas for a full all-you-can-eat experience featuring premium meats, sushi, and interactive tabletop grilling just off the Strip.

item.title: Kellogg Zaher Soccer Complex: More Than Just Soccer Fields
item.description: Kellogg Zaher Soccer Complex, known as KZ Park, is a top Las Vegas destination for youth soccer, tournaments, playgrounds, dog parks, tennis courts, and family-friendly outdoor fun.

item.title: Cafe Mong Expands to West Sahara — A Sweet Stop Worth the Drive
item.description: Cafe Mong’s new West Sahara location brings the same creative crepes, drinks, and charm to the Summerlin area, with a few differences worth noting.
